items.signal_prefix: ROADMAP AND TRANSITIONS: 40TB ePMR shipments COMMENCED in th

set.signal: ROADMAP AND TRANSITIONS: 40TB ePMR shipments COMMENCED in the June quarter and are now ENTERING VOLUME PRODUCTION WITH TWO CUSTOMERS, targeted to reach 50% OF NEARLINE BITS BY FISCAL Q3 2027. UltraSMR is ramping with a THIRD major customer and is expected to be ~60% OF NEARLINE EXABYTE SHIPMENTS EXITING FY2027. The 44TB HAMR product remains on track to ship in 1H CALENDAR 2027, with qualification feedback 'very positive' and capacity/performance/reliability 'exceeding customer expectations'; 50TB products follow in 2H CY2027. Beyond capacity, HIGH-BANDWIDTH DRIVES are now SAMPLING WITH FIVE CUSTOMERS, targeting UP TO 8x THE THROUGHPUT of today's drives with no corresponding increase in power draw - an attempt to extend HDDs into a new performance layer of the AI storage stack. Supply growth requires NO capex to add unit capacity; investment goes into heads/media operations and automation
set.figure: 40TB ePMR entering volume production at 2 customers (50% of nearline bits by FQ3'27); UltraSMR ~60% of nearline EB exiting FY27; 44TB HAMR 1H CY2027; high-bandwidth drives at 5 customers (8x throughput)

items.reason: CEO says 'now entering volume production with two customers' (not 'in volume production'); '(up from 2+1 last quarter)' appears nowhere in this call.
items.evidence: Irving Tan: For our next generation 40 terabyte ePMR drives, we commenced shipments in our June quarter, and are now entering volume production with two customers.

set.signal: BALANCE SHEET: the SanDisk stake is now FULLY MONETIZED - the remaining 1.7M SanDisk shares were exchanged for 4.8M WD shares in the quarter. The quarter ended with $1.1B of debt against $1.6B of cash for a NET POSITIVE CASH POSITION OF $500M
set.figure: net cash +$500M ($1.6B cash vs $1.1B debt); SanDisk stake fully monetized

items.reason: 'no appetite to re-lever' is not said: 'Do you want to put more debt on the balance sheet?' is analyst Aaron Rakers' question. The share repurchases, the $328M cash settlement of a convertible conversion premium, the dividend payments and the declared dividend with its record / pay dates, and the buyback / dividend return policy are financing / capital-return terms excluded by skill section 2; they are stripped from signal and figure, keeping the SanDisk stake exchange and the cash / debt / net-cash balance-sheet facts.
items.evidence: Kris Sennesael: we ended the quarter with $1.1 billion of debt and $1.6 billion of cash, resulting in a net positive cash position of $500 million.

items.signal_prefix: FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR AS A PURE-PLAY HDD COMPANY, and a blo

set.signal: FIRST FULL FISCAL YEAR AS A PURE-PLAY HDD COMPANY, and a blowout one: FY2026 revenue $12.9B (+36% YoY), gross margin 49.1% (+970bps), operating margin 37.3% (+1,290bps), EPS $10.22 (more than doubled), free cash flow $3.5B at a 27% FCF margin, and exabytes +25% YoY. Q4 itself: revenue $3.75B (+44% YoY) with revenue, gross margin and EPS all AT OR ABOVE THE HIGH END of guidance; EPS $3.56 (+109% YoY); 231 exabytes shipped (+22% YoY); operating income $1.66B (+126% YoY) at a 44.2% operating margin (+1,610bps YoY); operating cash flow $1.4B and free cash flow $1.3B (34% margin) on just $108M of capex. Q1 FY2027 guide: revenue $4.1B +/- $100M (+45% YoY at midpoint), gross margin 55-56%, opex $390-400M, tax 17%, EPS $4 +/- $0.15 on 388M shares
set.figure: FY26 rev $12.9B (+36%), EPS $10.22, FCF $3.5B; Q4 rev $3.75B, EPS $3.56; Q1 FY27 guide $4.1B / EPS $4

items.reason: Strips '$3.1B returned to shareholders' (capital return / buybacks and dividends, a financing item excluded by skill section 2); every other figure is unchanged and verbatim in the call. Also writes the guided EPS as stated ('$4, plus or minus $0.15'), not '$4.00'.
items.evidence: Kris Sennesael: We returned $3.1 billion to shareholders, reflecting our confidence in the durability of the business
